How do I share files with others?
To share a file, press and hold on it or enter its details and select the \"Share\" option. You can enter the recipient\'s email.
Yes, all deleted files go to the \"Trash\". You can enter it from the main menu and select the files you want to restore.
What advantages does the Premium plan have?
The Premium plan includes access to shared environments, version history of your files, and unlimited storage without advertising.
How do I change the application language?
Go to Settings -> Language and select between Spanish or English. The application will automatically restart with the new language.
Can I create a shared environment that only one of the users can modify?
Yes, when you add users you can assign them the role of administrator or member. Administrators are the only users capable of modifying the shared environment.
Can I access my files without an internet connection?

If you do not have an internet connection, you will only be able to access those files that you have previously downloaded. To download a file you must enter it. Press the options button (the button at the bottom of the screen) and then select the download option.
Is there a size limit for individual files?
No, as long as it fits in the remaining space of your account, it can be uploaded to the cloud.
If I cancel the subscription, will I still have the premium functions until the paid period ends?
Yes, premium functions will only be deactivated once the time you have paid for the premium version has ended.
Can I change my payment method after selecting one?

No, but you can activate an option that allows you to pay for a plan automatically after the previous one ends. To activate this option you must enter the user menu, select change payment plan and click on the renewal option. Once this is done, you will be able to select if you want your subscription to be renewed indefinitely, for the number of years you select or for the number of months you select. This option can be canceled at any time.
We accept card and online payment.
I have forgotten my password, how can I recover the account?

If you have forgotten your password, when it asks for it when logging in, click on the option \"Have you forgotten your password?\". This will send an email to the account you registered with where you can change the password.
Yes, at QuickFile we guarantee that your payment data is protected.
No one, your data will be protected according to the corresponding data protection law.
What happens if I run out of space?
You will not be able to upload any files unless you pay for the premium version or make space by deleting a file from your account.

To register an account, you must fill in the fields indicated on the screen: the username you wish to be identified by in the application, the email address associated with the account, the password for your QuickFile account, and the same password as entered in the previous field.

To log in, you must first have a registered account in QuickFile. If you already have an account, you must fill in the fields indicated on the screen: the account username and password. If you have forgotten your password or have any other questions, you can access the support menu.
To create a file, you must press the \"+\" symbol at the bottom of the screen, and then choose the file option.
To create a folder, you must press the \"+\" symbol at the bottom of the screen, and then choose the folder option.

You can access the trash from the main menu. Here you will find all the items you have temporarily deleted. You have the option to recover files if you made a mistake or delete them permanently to free up space in your account.
To navigate through your files, simply tap on any folder in the list. This will allow you to enter it and view the subfolders and files it contains, keeping your files organized.
By tapping on a file, you will access the details view. From here you can see relevant information such as the size, format, and extension of the file, as well as access its specific options.

Within the file details, you have several actions available: 

• Preview file: View content without downloading it.
• Share: Send the file to other users with read or edit permissions.
• Download: Save a copy on your device.
• Delete: Send the file to the trash.
• Report: Report an error or problem with the file.

In the profile icon of the top bar, you will find your personal menu. From here you can:

• Change user data (name and photo).
• Account settings (email and password).
• Change payment plan: Manage your subscription, automatic renewal, or cancellation.
• App reports: Report general failures.
• User support: FAQs, Manual, Contact, and Password recovery.
• Language change: Toggle between Spanish and English.

Access via the handshake icon to collaborate with others. You can add new environments, switch between them, and manage their settings. If you are an administrator, you can add users by email, change their permissions, or even leave the environment or delete it entirely.
